recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for HL7/fhir. If FHIR-51040 or another future work-group decision changes the deprecation outcome, apply that follow-up in HL7/fhir-extensions rather than in this core checkout.
issue_request: The Applied/Persuasive with Modification Jira asked to clarify the codesystem-use-markdown extension by changing the definition from concept definitions can be treated/rendered as markdown to should be treated/rendered as markdown, and to deprecate the extension.
initial_application: No current HL7/fhir commit directly mentions FHIR-40741. Core removed CodeSystem extension StructureDefinitions before this issue in dd468d4f17, while HL7/fhir-extensions commit 2d8d674 applied the should-wording/deprecated change and later extension-pack commits 50c9a0b, ea2d7b0, and 8cb3ce4 added/refined the deprecation reason, retired status, and vocab work-group metadata.
additional_context: Current HL7/fhir source has usages of http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/codesystem-use-markdown in CodeSystem instances and an OID/history record, but no current StructureDefinition source for the extension. The 2024-03-25 Terminology Infrastructure minutes confirm the decision to deprecate and link the Extension Pack artifact. Later FHIR-51040 asks to undeprecate the extension based on an NPU terminology use case, but it remains Submitted/Unresolved and does not supersede FHIR-40741.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined HL7/fhir branch. No core source change was made because the actionable source is in HL7/fhir-extensions and already reflects the approved FHIR-40741 result.

related_jiras.note: Submitted/Unresolved FHIR-extensions request to undeprecate codesystem-use-markdown based on a later NPU terminology use case; considered as context but not decided.
